cohort: A 45-year-old premenopausal woman with a significant smoking history and no previous history of cervical cancer screening.
finding: This case reports a rare presentation of Benign Metastasizing Leiomyoma (BML) in a 45-year-old woman, initially mimicking metastatic cervical cancer, which showed partial regression of lung nodules and symptomatic improvement following surgery and Megestrol treatment.
